title: Lab-on-a-Chip and Microrobotic Devices
description: Introduction to lab-on-a-chip and microrobotic devices with a focus on biomedical applications. Microfabrication techniques. Basics of micro- and nanoscale transport phenomena. Microsensors and microactuators. Microfluidic devices. Lab-on-a-chip systems. Microrobots
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( MECE E3100 ) and ( MECE E3311 ) MECE E3100 AND MECE E3311 ; course in transport phenomena, or instructor’s permission.
